title: Guided Onramp: Orchestrating SDKs, Docs, and Quickstarts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: reduce time-to-first-success for new developers integrating Redwood Inference by building a coordinated guided onramp that ties SDK starter kits, concise docs, and opinionated quickstarts into the Console experience. Scope: publish vetted starter templates for JS/Python/Go, three end-to-end quickstarts (chat app, embeddings search, batch inference), an interactive step-by-step Console walkthrough, and the telemetry to measure activation funnel and quality regressions. Hypothesis: a cohesive onramp will increase activation (first successful API call) rate from 28% to 55% and reduce median time-to-first-success from 42 minutes to under 12 minutes for self-serve signups.
acceptance_criteria: Publish SDK starter templates for JavaScript, Python, and Go with README and CI tests
Three quickstarts with sample repos and infra-as-code: chat, embeddings search, and batch job
Console integrated walkthrough that launches a quickstart and provisions demo credentials in sandbox mode
Telemetry: instrument events for 'onramp_start', 'first_request_success', 'quickstart_cloned', and dashboard showing funnel conversion and time metrics
Docs: concise 5-min quickstart pages with copy, CLI commands, and expected outputs; validated in user testing (n>=8)
Retention guardrails: fallback guidance for quota errors and clear upgrade CTA
comments: 2026-02-12 - Kickoff with Eng (Ravi), Design (Marta) and Growth (Cam). Agreed to scope three quickstarts prioritizing highest signal from user interviews.
2026-02-24 - Design review: Marta provided low-fidelity flows for Console walkthrough. PM prefers inline 'Try this request' over full environment provisioning to reduce infra risk.
2026-03-01 - Eng sync: agreed to reuse runtime sandbox and ephemeral API keys. Decision: start with v1 templates using existing SDKs; follow-up ticket to add language parity automation.
2026-03-05 - PR opened for JS starter template: github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/1427. Tests passing locally; needs CI secrets step from infra.
2026-03-07 - UX testing (n=10) on draft quickstart: median completion time 15m; common friction: unclear error for missing billing. Action: add explicit 'sandbox quota' note and fallback flow.
2026-03-09 - Security notes: secrets rotation pattern reviewed with Security (Diego). No additional controls required for sandbox keys but audit logging must be enabled for release.
2026-03-10 - Blocker: Console integration requires a small backend endpoint (ENG-19804) for ephemeral key minting. Dependency added; ETA 2026-03-22.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: full environment provisioning increases fidelity but would add infra and cost; chosen approach prioritizes speed and observability for initial release.
Follow-up work planned: automated language parity pipeline (PM follow-up), advanced quickstarts for Dedicated customers, and A/B test for Console walkthrough placement.
Metrics to track post-release: activation conversion, median time-to-first-success, quickstart repo clones, sandbox churn rate, and NPS for onboarding experience.
